results.title: Cost of Living Adjustments for Service-Connected Benefits
results.abstract: As required by the Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2025, Public Law 119-42, the VA is hereby giving notice of adjustments in certain benefit rates. These adjustments affect the compensation program.
